stem: Which of these is a guarantee in the First Amendment?

options.label: A
options.text: States have the power to regulate public education.

options.label: B
options.text: People can choose whether and how to participate in religious services.

options.label: C
options.text: Persons accused of a crime are presumed innocent until proven guilty.

options.label: D
options.text: Citizens have the right to be judged by a jury of their peers.
